description: Search public LinkedIn posts by keywords or Boolean query, with optional author, age and sort filters. Get post text, dates and engagement as JSON. Use it to find company announcements, product mentions and relevant discussions without knowing the post URLs first. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon.

author_url.description: optional LinkedIn profile or company page URL

limit.description: number of posts wanted, 1 to 20 (default 5). A larger value is lowered to 20 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

name: linkedin-post-search
title: Search LinkedIn posts
